from harvests import load_harvests, ROWS
from podium import podium, report


def test_count():
    assert report(list(load_harvests()))["count"] == len(ROWS)


def test_podium_values():

    assert [x.kilos for x in top] == sorted((v for _, v in ROWS), reverse=True)[:3]
